# Mahapatra Plumbing Services

> Plumbing company in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. Base: District Center, Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751016. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9668875352. Open daily 8 AM – 10 PM; late-night and early-morning visits on request, subject to availability (+₹300). Owner: Amaresh Mahapatra (20+ years of plumbing experience; business started in 2021). Rated 5.0 on Google from 45 reviews. Serves all of Bhubaneswar.

Facts as of 27 November 2026.

Key facts:
- Google rating: 5.0 from 45 reviews (27 November 2026).
- Visit charge ₹199–₹349, adjusted in the final bill if the work goes ahead.
- 90-day workmanship warranty on installation and repair jobs. Parts follow the brand's own warranty.
- Free site visit and written estimate for big works: bathroom renovation, new house plumbing, concealed pipeline, sewerage and commercial jobs.
- Prices are labour only; parts are extra and the part price is shared before fitting.
- Languages: Odia, Hindi and English. Payment: cash, UPI or bank transfer; GST invoice on request.
- Booking is by phone or WhatsApp only; there is no walk-in counter.
- We do not drill new borewells.

## Services

- [Water leakage and tap repair](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/leak-and-blockage-repair/): dripping taps, running flushes, toilet leaks; minor fix from ₹249
- [Bathroom and kitchen fittings](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/bathroom-and-kitchen-fittings/): taps, jet sprays, flush kits, WC, basin, sink; ₹299–₹799 + parts
- [Geyser installation and repair](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/geyser-installation-and-repair/): plumbing side; installation from ₹699, service ₹499
- [Water tank and motor repair](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/water-tank-and-motor-repair/): pumps, foot and float valves, tank overflow; from ₹399
- [Concealed pipeline repair and CPVC plumbing](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/pipeline-and-concealed-plumbing/): wall and floor leaks, rerouting, GI to CPVC
- [Drain cleaning and sewer jetting](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/drain-cleaning-and-sewer-jetting/): sink and floor trap unclogging from ₹349, toilet blockage removal from ₹999
- [Septic tank cleaning](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/septic-tank-cleaning/): homes, PGs, apartments, shops; from ₹2,999
- [Water tank and sump cleaning](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/water-tank-cleaning/): overhead tanks and underground sumps; quote on call or WhatsApp
- [Borewell pump and pipe repair](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/borewell-pump-and-pipe-repair/): existing borewells only
- [Bathroom renovation plumbing](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/bathroom-plumbing-renovation/): free site visit, written estimate
- [New house and bathroom plumbing](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/new-bathroom-and-house-plumbing/): free site visit, written estimate
- [Sewerage and drainage works](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/sewerage-and-drainage-works/): new sewer connections need WATCO approval
- [Commercial plumbing](https://mahapatraplumbing.in/services/commercial-plumbing/): hotels, offices, hostels, PGs and shops
